title: Uniqueness of Tangent Cones for Area-Minimizing Integral Currents in Higher Codimension
exact_target: At every interior point of an area-minimizing integral current in higher codimension, do all infinitesimal blow-up sequences converge to the same tangent cone?

sources.citation: Skorobogatova, Singularities of area-minimizing integral currents: recent progress and open directions, Seminaire Laurent Schwartz EDP et applications (2025).
